Remark
[Caveats about the asymptotic soliton] ↗ thm:asymptotic-gradient-shrinking-soliton

The theorem does not assert bounded curvature on each limiting time-slice, so in general the limit is not yet known to extend to a $\kappa $-solution. Nor does it yet produce the usual self-similar diffeomorphisms. Both conclusions are established below in dimensions two and three (Corollaries 26 and 4.4).
